algorithm.fit_word_selection: exclude discovery types containing unknown atom -1, then top512 known-input types by descending occurrence count, lexicographic opaque atom array ties; retain all original discovery records/types for held novelty; never filter using expanded-side/gold flags
algorithm.output_alphabet: all Unicode codepoints appearing in exact other-five-book reference words, sorted by Unicode; engineering capacity 2..1024 codepoints
algorithm.mapping: many-to-one global one-character output per opaque atom; unsupported held atoms absent actual top512 fit inventory force empty predictions
algorithm.marker: none or one fit-supported opaque atom; all occurrences removed to obtain ordered carriers; observed position never supplies missing-letter position

channel.L: all atoms ordinary, exact resulting word
channel.C: at least2 retained carriers if marked; reference word must contain carriers in order; omitted sequence equals global residual r repeated k marker occurrences; total omitted0..4
channel.V: at least2 retained carriers if marked; reference word contains carriers in order, with total omitted0..4; arbitrary omitted sequence
channel.unmarked: exact literal decoding in every arm
channel.multiple_alignments: reference word counts once per contract, never by number of alignments
channel.constant_domain: empty residual plus every residual inferred from discovery/reference compatible alignments that is exact k-fold repetition; no held or gold domain information

surrogate.model: reference within-word character4gram, three start pads and one terminal; start not an output
surrogate.smoothing: .1 additive to every reference character and terminal for every history; denominator contextcount+.1*(A+1)
surrogate.word_score: sum transition natural logs divided by decoded length+1 including terminal
surrogate.objective: occurrence-weighted mean of word scores over actual top512 discovery types

search.rng_integer: rng()%n; modulo choice intentional and frozen
search.initial_key: rank atom occurrence frequency in actual fit types and character occurrence frequency in reference, descending count/ID tie; atom rank i maps to character rank i modulo A
search.start_perturbation: start0 unperturbed; starts1..7 exactly10 swaps of two independently drawn supported atoms, allowing same atom
search.forced_moves: uniform integer0..99: <50 swap two distinct supported atom values, else replace one supported atom by uniform reference character
search.latent_moves: <45 swap, <90 replace, else choose uniformly among supported marker atoms+none
search.accept: delta>=0 or log(U)<delta/temperature; delta is change of occurrence-weighted mean surrogate; no gold
search.panel: all32 snapshots retained with duplicates, accessible to every final arm; no best-state substitution
search.objective_recheck: direct surrogate recomputed each snapshot, after incremental consistency assertion

dictionary_score.reference_prior: exact other-five-book reference occurrence count / total reference occurrences, no smoothing
dictionary_score.compatible_word_weight: reference_prior*2^(-d), d=reference character length-retained carrier length
dictionary_score.word_mass: sum compatible reference words once each
dictionary_score.objective: sum over top512 discovery types count*log(1e-8+(1-1e-8)*word_mass); unnormalized compatibility/search score, not likelihood or calibrated probability
dictionary_score.search: all32 keys, all fit-supported marker choices+none; all finite discovery-derived constant residuals; L only none
dictionary_score.ties: within1e-12 below actual maximum; select lexicographically(key output-ID array,marker with none=-1,residual character-ID array,panel index); retain all tied candidates

prediction.unlock: KEY_SELECTION_LOCK precedes first HOLDOUT_INPUT read; explicit root PREDICTION_RELEASE required
prediction.ranking: compatible references descending weight then exact Unicode lexical word; fixed first5, report all cutoff ties without expanding top5
prediction.no_compatible_words: empty candidate list, no free filler
prediction.gold: never opened by fitter/predictor; separate scorer after PREDICTION_LOCK

limitations: supplied word/atom boundaries and reference language inventory
single variable-sign hypothesis, not full historical inverse
whole-word/multichar glyphs may be unsupported and remain errors
heuristic32-state panel not exhaustive global-key optimization
first two original examples already design-exposed; no fresh analyst blindness

primary_endpoint.unknown_policy: known written novel types K macro credit; every held abbreviated occurrence with unknown written or unknown expansion contributes mandatory zero-credit unit U; denominator K+U; do not call U distinct lexical types
primary_endpoint.novelty: against ALL130 discovery record written types, not top512 fitting subset
primary_endpoint.claim_ceiling: source-only candidate generation; no target decoding or calibrated semantic probability; no significance claim
